Chapter 380: Chapter 4 Golden Dragon Star Master: Jin Tianzhao, This Is Your Good Deed! (Please Subscribe)_3

Afterward, people from the Wangyue Starfield came to investigate and were shocked to find that this Dead Star was a resource planet containing precious resources.

Its value was immense, being fully mined, it was worth at least ten thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

This attracted the attention of the Golden Dragon Star Domain,

Evolvers from the Golden Dragon lineage argued that since the Dead Star had once been located at the border area between two Star Domains, it should be jointly managed by both, with them wanting to take 80% of the profits.

The Wangyue Starfield naturally disagreed, as the Dead Star had drifted into their territory, it naturally belonged to them.

The two sides then began to argue.

...

“The Star Lord of the Golden Dragon Star Domain, taking advantage of his wide network, proactively applied for this issue to be discussed at the Star Alliance conference, and we from the Wangyue Starfield could only keep inviting other Seventh-Level Citizens…”

The Star Lord of Wangyue said in a low voice.

“The Wangyue Starfield is willing to pay two thousand Universe Crystals to ask Lord Shisan to veto this matter and delay it as much as possible.”

The Star Lord of Wangyue revealed his purpose.

The reason for the delay is because the resources of the resource planet can be collected.

The longer the delay, the more resources the Evolvers of the Wangyue Starfield can collect; if they can delay past this Star Alliance conference and before the next one arrives, the Wangyue Starfield is confident of collecting 70% of the resources.

“Two thousand Universe Crystals…”

Lin Yuan’s expression remained unchanged.

This remuneration was already considerable, as the legacy left by the Eighth Layer Evolutionist Ou Yin contained only a thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

Two thousand Universe Crystals was already considered to be half a fortune for a seasoned Eighth Layer Evolutionist.

“If Lord Shisan thinks it’s too low, then make it three thousand Universe Crystals.”

The Star Lord of Wangyue said through clenched teeth.

Even if they successfully collected 70% of the resources, it would be worth approximately seven thousand Universe Crystals, subtracting various costs, the Wangyue Starfield would at most acquire about six thousand Universe Crystals, giving Lin Yuan three thousand Universe Crystals was already very sincere.

“No problem.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

“Thank you, Lord Shisan.”

The Star Lord of Wangyue sighed deeply with relief internally.

There are a total of fifty-six councilors in the Annan Star Alliance.

Excluding those who rarely show their faces, there are only about ten or so who regularly participate in the Star Alliance conference.

And these ten or so, the Star Lord of Wangyue couldn’t invite a single one, either because they didn’t want to offend the Golden Dragon Star Lord or for other reasons.

…

Golden Dragon Star Domain.

Golden Dragon Main Star.

The Golden Dragon Star Lord sat on his golden throne, his consciousness connected to the Virtual World.

“Huh?”

“An extra councilor in the Annan Star Alliance? Code name ‘Shisan’?”

“Why does this ‘Shisan’ sound so familiar?”

The Golden Dragon Star Lord, what a being he was, after a bit of careful thought, confirmed that ‘Shisan’ shared a name with the mysterious Seventh-Level Citizen that Jin Tianzhao had upfront offended.

“The same name?”

The Golden Dragon Star Lord thought for a moment and immediately started to inquire.

“It’s not a coincidence; this new councilor is that ‘Shisan’.”

The Golden Dragon Star Lord immediately sensed trouble, as if Lin Yuan were only a Sixth-Level Citizen, he could be disregarded, but a Seventh-Level Citizen… how many are there in the whole Annan Star Alliance.

The reason the Golden Dragon Star Lord had previously ignored Lin Yuan was because he thought it would be many years before Lin Yuan could become a Seventh-Level Citizen.

Did it happen so soon?

“This Jin Tianzhao, always not making things easy for me, casually offended a Seventh-Level Citizen?”

The Golden Dragon Star Lord’s brow furrowed tightly, and he immediately summoned Jin Tianzhao.

“Did the master call for me?”

Jin Tianzhao had just finished his retreat and had received the summons from the Golden Dragon Star Lord.

“What’s the matter?”

“The master’s tone doesn’t sound good?”

Jin Tianzhao was somewhat nervous as he approached the grand hall of the Golden Dragon Star Lord.

“Jin Tianzhao.”

The Golden Dragon Star Lord looked down at Jin Tianzhao, “What have you done!?”
